generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, features a steampunk fish and a luminous pink donut with a witty headline. The poster centers on a stylized, engraved illustration of a steampunk-style fish, primarily teal, metallic, and segmented with brass gears and portholes, appearing somewhat off to the side with a neutral expression. Its round yellow eyes glow subtly, and a small trail of bubbles rises from its back. Beside it, a luminous pink donut with a holographic shimmer and brightly colored, translucent sprinkles floats, appearing weightless. At the top, a bold headline in a mid-century serif font declares, "GEARS BEFORE QUEERS!" with starburst icons. A tagline beneath adds, "Still Buffering," and a funny footer states, "Mentally ooo."
